title: HI3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D): Object-specific 3D Asset Generation with High Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.11685v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image-to-3D generation has become increasingly capable of producing objects that closely resemble the input image, and an outstanding challenge is to reproduce the depicted object itself, including the specific geometry that defines it. Inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures are frequently distorted or lost, despite being critical to object identity. We present Hi3D 3.0, an image-to-3D generation system targeting object-specific fidelity, with Twinkle3D as its geometry model for generating watertight triangle meshes at $2048^{3}$ resolution. Twinkle3D advances high-fidelity geometry generation along four dimensions. First, while O-Voxel/FaithC offers high representational precision, it often suffers from poor surface quality and non-watertight geometry. translated_title: HI3D 3.0（Twinkle3D）：高分辨率的特定物体3D资产生成
translated_abstract: 图像到3D生成已越来越能够生成与输入图像高度相似的物体，但一个尚未解决的挑战是重现所描绘的物体本身，包括定义该物体的特定几何结构。铭文、品牌标识和重复结构尽管对物体的身份至关重要，却经常被扭曲或丢失。我们提出了Hi3D 3.0，这是一个以物体特定保真度为目标的图像到3D生成系统，其几何模型Twinkle3D能够在$2048^{3}$分辨率下生成水密三角网格。Twinkle3D在四个维度上推进了高保真几何生成。首先，虽然O-Voxel/FaithC提供了较高的表征精度，但常常存在表面质量差和几何非水密的问题，我们在保留其$2048^{3}$级精度的同时解决了这两个问题。其次，我们通过重新设计的（方法）将扩散生成扩展到多达30万几何token的序列。
tldr: Hi3D 3.0提出几何模型Twinkle3D，可在2048³分辨率下生成水密三角网格，通过保留高精度表征、解决表面质量与水密性问题并将扩散生成扩展至30万几何token等改进，实现对铭文、品牌标识等物体特定细节的高保真3D资产生成。
en_tdlr: Hi3D 3.0 introduces Twinkle3D, a geometry model that generates watertight triangle meshes at 2048³ resolution, achieving object-specific high-fidelity 3D asset generation (preserving inscriptions, brand marks, and repeated structures) through improvements including 2048³-level precision, better surface quality and watertightness, and diffusion scaling to 300K geometric tokens.
